name: SparkFun Qwiic Soil Moisture Sensor
description: Resistive soil moisture probe (two gold-plated ENIG pads) read over I2C: an ATtiny85 running the Zio/SparkFun gateway firmware measures the pads against a 100 kOhm pull-up with its 10-bit ADC and returns the raw reading (1023 = dry/open, lower = wetter) on command 0x05; commands 0x00/0x01 switch a green LED. 3.3 V Qwiic board with 4.7 kOhm I2C pull-ups, I2C address 0x28 (changeable in software, kept in EEPROM). Sold as: SparkFun Qwiic Soil Moisture Sensor (SEN-17731), one Qwiic JST-SH connector GND, 3.3V, SDA, SCL plus an unpopulated 2x3 ICSP header.
eli5: Two metal fingers you push into a plant pot; the board tells your microcontroller over two wires how wet the soil between them is.

pins.name: 3.3V
pins.description: Supply, 3.3 V (Qwiic pin 2, red wire). No regulator; the I2C pull-ups and the ADC reference are this rail. Never 5 V.

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (Qwiic pin 3, blue wire; 4.7 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V on the board, jumper JP3)

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (Qwiic pin 4, yellow wire; 4.7 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V on the board, jumper JP3)

supplierQuery: SparkFun Qwiic Soil Moisture Sensor SEN-17731
buildNotes: Commands are single bytes written to 0x28: 0x01 = LED on, 0x00 = LED off. Write 0x05, then read 2 bytes: the 10-bit ADC value, LOW byte first.
Reading = 1024 x Rprobe / (Rprobe + 100 kOhm), capped at 1023: 1023 in air (dry), falling toward 0 as the soil gets wetter. SparkFun's library reports wetness % = (1023 - raw) / 1023 x 100.
Calibrate in your own soil: note the reading in dry soil and just after watering, and set your watering threshold between them.
Power it from 3.3 V only (Qwiic); the 4.7 kOhm I2C pull-ups go to the board's own 3.3 V. Cut JP3 if many pulled-up boards share the bus.
Write 0x03 <addr> to store a new address (0x08-0x77) in EEPROM; it answers at the new address at once.
Coat the electronics end (not the pads) with conformal coating or hot glue if it lives outdoors; push only the pads into the soil.

driver.code:
# SparkFun Qwiic Soil Moisture Sensor (SEN-17731), MicroPython driver.
# The board's ATtiny85 runs the Zio/SparkFun "Qwiic Soil Moisture" gateway firmware: a one-byte
# command protocol, not a register map (Qwiic_Soil_Moisture_Firmware.ino):
#   0x00 = LED off, 0x01 = LED on, 0x03 <addr> = change I2C address (EEPROM, 0x08-0x77),
#   0x05 = get value: the next read returns the 10-bit ADC reading, LOW byte first, then HIGH byte.
# The ADC reads the probe pads against a 100 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V (VCC reference), so
# raw = 1024 * Rprobe / (Rprobe + 100k), capped at 1023: 1023 = dry (open probe), lower = wetter.
import time

CMD_LED_OFF = 0x00
CMD_LED_ON = 0x01
CMD_CHANGE_ADDRESS = 0x03
CMD_GET_VALUE = 0x05

MAX_VALUE = 1023
PULLUP_OHMS = 100000


class QwiicSoilMoisture:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x28):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr

    def _cmd(self, c):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes([c]))

    def led_on(self):
        self._cmd(CMD_LED_ON)

    def led_off(self):
        self._cmd(CMD_LED_OFF)

    def read_raw(self):
        """10-bit ADC reading 0-1023 (0 = probes shorted by water, 1023 = dry / in air)."""
        self._cmd(CMD_GET_VALUE)
        time.sleep_ms(1)  # let the ATtiny's I2C interrupt latch the command
        d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 2)
        return (d[0] | (d[1] << 8)) & 0x3FF

    def read_ratio(self):
        """Wetness 0.0 (dry) to 1.0 (wet), as SparkFun's library computes it: (1023 - raw) / 1023."""
        return (MAX_VALUE - self.read_raw()) / MAX_VALUE

    def read_percent(self):
        return self.read_ratio() * 100.0

    def probe_ohms(self):
        """Resistance between the probe pads in ohms (None when open / dry: raw 1023)."""
        raw = self.read_raw()
        if raw >= MAX_VALUE:
            return None
        return PULLUP_OHMS * raw / (1024 - raw)

    def change_address(self, new_addr):
        """Store a new I2C address (0x08-0x77) in the board's EEPROM; it answers there at once."""
        if not 0x07 < new_addr < 0x78:
            raise ValueError('address must be 0x08-0x77')
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes([CMD_CHANGE_ADDRESS, new_addr]))
        self.addr = new_addr

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from qwiic_soil import QwiicSoilMoisture

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
soil = QwiicSoilMoisture(i2c)  # 0x28
soil.led_on()
while True:
    raw = soil.read_raw()
    wet = (1023 - raw) * 100 / 1023
    print('RAW=%d WET=%.1f%%' % (raw, wet))
    time.sleep(1)
